principles: Auto-accumulate at the reliable choke point (DONE merge), same mechanism as auto-bump/auto-rebuild.
Never block the merge: the cache is advisory; refresh failure is swallowed + reported, never fatal.
Make silent failure LOUD: a coverage watermark + gap report turns a missed/failed refresh into a detectable, recoverable signal.
Additive + back-compatible: watermark fields are optional; old caches degrade to needs-scan, never crash.
Reuse existing recovery: learning_scan full re-derive closes any gap; no new recovery command.
drivers: The cache only updates on a manual out-of-band learning_scan today → it silently rots; the operator wants experience to accumulate per-story AND a bug that drops a story to be detectable + recoverable.
A never-throw auto-refresh alone has a silent-failure hole; the watermark/gap is what makes it trustworthy.
Story ids are hashes, not integers — so the "sequence number" must be a coverage count + timestamp watermark.

options.name: done-merge-hook-plus-watermark-and-validate-gap
pros: Reliable: fires on every story DONE; catches the just-merged story.
Watermark makes the never-throw refresh trustworthy (detect+recover).
Same site/mechanism as auto-bump/auto-rebuild; advisory, never blocks.
cons: Touches several experience-layer files (done-effects, finding-signals, types, revalidation, learning-validate) — but all one cohesive concern.

options.name: cron-or-CI-schedule
cons: Main cron unreliable; misses the just-merged story; lag; out-of-band like today.

options.name: pre-review-agent-step
cons: Depends on the agent remembering — the exact failure we are removing.

rationale: Wiring the never-throw cache re-derive into applyDoneMergeEffects (beside auto-bump/auto-rebuild) makes experience accumulate on every story DONE; pairing it with a coverage watermark + a learning_validate gap report makes the never-throw refresh trustworthy (a silent miss is detectable and recoverable via learning_scan). Cron/CI and agent-step alternatives are unreliable or reintroduce the manual dependency.

preMortem.scenario: The cache refresh throws/hangs and breaks or slows the DONE merge.
preMortem.trigger: Not wrapping the re-derive in try/catch, or doing heavy work in the lock.
preMortem.consequence: A story cannot DONE because of an advisory cache refresh — unacceptable.
preMortem.mitigation: Wrap the re-derive in try/catch; on any error append an advisory mergeLines line and continue; the re-derive is a cheap store-read + JSON write; a smoke asserts a forced derive failure leaves the merge succeeding.

preMortem.scenario: An old cache without watermark fields crashes learning_validate or reports a bogus huge gap.
preMortem.consequence: learning_validate breaks or cries wolf on legacy caches.
preMortem.mitigation: Treat missing watermark as "coverage unknown → run learning_scan" (not a numeric gap); a smoke covers a watermark-less cache.

preMortem.scenario: The gap is a false positive/negative because the watermark counts and the store counts are computed differently.
preMortem.trigger: Counting findings differently at write-time vs validate-time (e.g. filters, dedup).
preMortem.consequence: Gap shows non-zero right after a fresh scan, or hides a real miss.
preMortem.mitigation: Compute coveredFindingCount with the SAME counting used by deriveFindingSignalsFromStore; the smoke asserts gap=0 immediately after learning_scan and gap=delta after adding a finding without scan.
